method: All numbers were measured on 2026-09-05 against the tot pin worktree /Users/oobi/Documents/kan-lang-tot-pin at 8cf0b8b with porcelain 0.  The timer is zsh /Users/oobi/Documents/kanon/dev/bench.sh NAME CMD: it runs CMD once untimed as a warm-up, then five timed runs of /bin/zsh -f -c CMD under /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 -P with time.perf_counter_ns around subprocess.run, stdin, stdout and stderr on /dev/null, and it prints median, min and max in milliseconds.  The corpus is lib/*.ml plus lib/*.mli from the pin, listed by ls -1 lib/*.ml lib/*.mli piped to sort, counted by wc -l (4969 lines over 19 files) and hashed by cat of that sorted list piped to shasum -a 256.  tot_suite_kernel_warm_ms times the prebuilt suite binary: cd /Users/oobi/Documents/kan-lang-tot-pin/_build/default/test and ./main.exe, checked once for exit 0 from that directory before timing.  ocamlopt_ms_per_kloc times zsh /Users/oobi/Documents/kanon/dev/pin-dune.sh clean followed by zsh /Users/oobi/Documents/kanon/dev/pin-dune.sh build -j 1 ./lib as one timed run, so the clean is inside the measurement; value is median_ms divided by 4.969.  ocamlopt_ms_per_kloc_parallel is the same pair with the default -j and is informational.  runner_overhead_ms is bench.sh over zsh /Users/oobi/Documents/kanon/dev/pin-dune.sh --version and is informational.  The runner dev/pin-dune.sh puts /Users/oobi/.opam/zxcaml-p1/bin first on PATH, clears the user chpwd hooks, cds into the pin and execs dune 3.24.2 with ocamlopt 5.2.1.  After the measurements a full zsh /Users/oobi/Documents/kanon/dev/pin-dune.sh build restored _build/default/test/main.exe.  Host facts come from uname -m, getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN and sw_vers -productVersion because sysctl is denied in the sandbox.
